optimization_priority.gain_formula: For affected scored classes c: expected whole-entry time reduction = sum(w_c * r_c); r_c = 1 - 1/s_c for a local speedup factor s_c. Account for actual hit coverage; avoid double-counting it.
optimization_priority.evidence_requirement: Record measured time share, achievable reduction range and supporting mechanism/diagnostic, coverage, total development/proof/queue/collection/confirmation cost, and next falsifiable check for each route. optimization_priority.cost_rule: Compare credible whole-entry gain with total cost and reusable value; no fabricated success probability or mandatory single gain-per-hour score.
